referenceSources.description:
This rare left-hand drive 1998 Ford Puma Super 1600 rally car, one of only two built by Ford, is displayed under the OppositeStock Modern Classics Specialist sign. It features the original red, white, and blue Ford Rallye Sport livery, Pirelli branding, and a prominent rear spoiler. The carbon bonnet with roof intake, carbon front bumper, and widened Super 1600 body arches underline its competition pedigree.

Originally used for development and promotional duties, the car was later acquired by Alan Farmer of Pumabuild and transformed into a dedicated track machine. Highlights include a 6-speed manual gearbox, Quaife ATB differential, magnesium wheels, FIA-spec Sparco carbon seats with harness, Alcon brakes, full roll cage, and a Zafco fire suppression system. With just 4,000 miles recorded and a comprehensive spare parts package, this Puma is offered for sale in Berwick-upon-Tweed, Northumberland, UK.
